arguments.sql: SELECT id, date, errors FROM transactions WHERE errors IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
arguments.explanation: Lists the id, date and error for every transaction that has a recorded error, ordered by id.
assumptions: An error is any transaction whose errors column is not NULL; NULL means no error.
No date filter applied, so the full 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 range is included.
Results are ordered by transaction id.
